note: Rustic state forest campground on the north shore of Tomahawk Lake (Minocqua Chain), with a sandy swimming beach, a boat landing near the entrance and the paved Clear Lake/Indian Mounds bike trail. --Claude
summary: DNR rustic-campgrounds page and the 2025 brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 39 sites (31 drive-in, 8 walk-to tent), no electric, vault toilets, hand pumps, reservations required; season Apr 30-Columbus Day matches the stored manual season. Stored lakefront fails on imagery: LEAD lakefront -> lakeview. Pin ~130 m north of the loops (fine). Phone null -> 715-356-3668. Website /topic/parks/northernhighland is 404.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade): stored lakefront -> lakeview. On Esri imagery (leaf-off) every loop is under continuous forest. East loop: the paved loop road runs between sites 1-23 and the south shore; the land between road and water (~25-40 m) is a band of mixed conifers and hardwoods holding the walk-to tent sites 24-25 and the campground's own beach (day use). Drive-in 19 and 21 hang just south of the road but still sit behind that tree band. West loop (28, 32-39): the spurs end about 30-50 m from the west shore through a continuous band of conifers. No drive-in site is on open ground within ~50 m of the water, so lakefront is not earned; leaf-off imagery shows the lake close behind thin tree bands at 19/21 and 32-37, which supports a filtered lakeview.
PHONE: null -> 715-356-3668 (Clear Lake Visitor Station, the brochure's 'For questions, contact'; Crystal Lake Visitor Station 715-542-3923 is the forest's other number).

WEBSITE: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/northernhighland -> https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/nhal/recreation/camping/rustic (old link answers 404; the forest page is https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/nhal). Keep wisconsin.goingtocamp.com.
